# Policymaker #900: iteration 0210 (trigger: every 3 iterations)

The owner does not need to do anything. I made no Owner request and no change to the organization.

I read records 0207, 0208 and 0209 and the session reports #889, #896 and #898 (`.session/history/sessions/<issue>/`). All three iterations closed. 0208 and 0209 are accepted and improved. 0207 has verdict `none`. `no_progress` is 0.

- The citation thread is closed. #889 added `citation_resolves` to `benchmark/scripts/score.py`. It stopped `partial` at its 60-turn limit, with its work saved on branch `task/889`. The finish task #893 continued on that branch and merged (38a3e203). Review #894 is CLEAR.
- Design Limit 4 is closed. #897 changed the citation shape in `answer_record_contract` and merged (7f9dde12). Review #898 is CLEAR: 62/62 input pins and 80/80 `preparation.json` entries match disk.
- Two existing orchestrator rules worked again: "finish on the saved branch" (#694) and "recompute the whole pin map" (#863). I keep both.
- Cost data point: #889 used 14.13M cache-read tokens in 60 turns. That is about 4.7 times all of iteration 0209. This is one data point, so I did not change a rule. Token counters do not measure quota.
- In 0208, wall time was 10,607 s, but the critical path was only 331 s. #893 waited 9,415 s for a provider (5 attempts). This is provider waiting, not task work.
- Reviewers #894 and #898 used Claude Sonnet, the same model family as the authors. Same-family review stays a stated limitation.

`.session/orders.json` is `{"wake": false, "tasks": []}`. The Shaper chooses the next method gap. Benchmark readiness and product quality are still not measured. There is no accepted Goal gate.

## What next

- Saved work: `policy/working-memory.md`, section "Latest: Policymaker #900".
- Next Policymaker: read the Shaper's choice of the next gap and its results.
- If one benchmark or implementation task uses more than about 5M cache-read tokens, read its report. Then think about adding an orchestrator scoping rule.
- Do not review the citation thread again without a new contradiction.

Waiting for the iteration to continue: then `policy/` merges and the orders start.
